title: Claude spend and tokens
description: Spend and tokens by model and UTC day: the live OTel stream (VictoriaMetrics) on the left, the SQLite build from bin/metrics-db on the right.

targets.rawQueryText: select coalesce(sum(c.cost_usd), 0) as usd from session_cost c join sessions s using (session_id) where c.model != '<synthetic>' and s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
targets.queryText: select coalesce(sum(c.cost_usd), 0) as usd from session_cost c join sessions s using (session_id) where c.model != '<synthetic>' and s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')

panels.title: Spend by model per day, live
panels.description: claude_code.cost.usage, summed per UTC day. Counts every API request, subagents included, as it happens.

panels.title: Spend by model per day, SQLite build
panels.description: session_cost from bin/metrics-db, dated by the day each session ended (UTC); fresh only as of the last build.

targets.rawQueryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(s.ts)) as integer) as time, c.model as model, sum(c.cost_usd) as usd from session_cost c join sessions s using (session_id) where c.model != '<synthetic>' and s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') group by 1, 2 order by 1
targets.queryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(s.ts)) as integer) as time, c.model as model, sum(c.cost_usd) as usd from session_cost c join sessions s using (session_id) where c.model != '<synthetic>' and s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Tokens by model per day, live
panels.description: claude_code.token.usage, all four types (input, output, cache read, cache creation) summed per UTC day.

panels.title: Tokens by model per day, SQLite build
panels.description: sessions from bin/metrics-db, the same four types; a session's tokens all go to its main model, so subagents on other models land there too.

targets.rawQueryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(ts)) as integer) as time, model, sum(tokens) as tokens from (select s.ts as ts, coalesce((select c.model from session_cost c where c.session_id = s.session_id and c.model != '<synthetic>' order by c.cost_usd desc limit 1), nullif(s.model, '<synthetic>')) as model, coalesce(s.input_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.output_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.cache_creation_tokens, 0) as tokens from sessions s where s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) where model is not null group by 1, 2 order by 1
targets.queryText: select cast(strftime('%s', date(ts)) as integer) as time, model, sum(tokens) as tokens from (select s.ts as ts, coalesce((select c.model from session_cost c where c.session_id = s.session_id and c.model != '<synthetic>' order by c.cost_usd desc limit 1), nullif(s.model, '<synthetic>')) as model, coalesce(s.input_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.output_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.cache_read_tokens, 0) + coalesce(s.cache_creation_tokens, 0) as tokens from sessions s where s.ts >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') and s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', $__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')) where model is not null group by 1, 2 order by 1
